game.title: FREE CITY: ODYSSEY
maya.start: Noa! Over here. The city stuttered this morning and you are the only other person who noticed.
zed.start: Psst. You are the anomaly everyone is whispering about. Take this note.
ivy.start: Still hunting the photo spots? The light pools near the west park gate, the east overlook, and the harbor.
lore.garden: They say the northwest park used to be a real garden — wild, unscripted.
lore.architect: The Architect watches through the lamps. Or so the rumor goes.
lore.devoffice: The Dev Office knows more than they say. They always do.
lore.fragments: Six fragments of the First World are hidden in the city. Nobody remembers why.
